lines.en: label wakanadate5:
I tap on Wakana’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer, hoping that, wherever she is, it isn’t at[school].
lines.zh: 我在手机上点了 Wakana 的名字等她接，心里祈祷着，不管她在哪儿，别是在[school]。

lines.en: I really don’t like the idea of her using my friendship for the sole purpose of grading papers faster, but I have a creeping suspicion that last time was not actually the last.
lines.zh: 我很不喜欢她把我当朋友的目的只是为了让卷子改得更快，可我有种越来越强的怀疑：上一次并不是最后一次。

lines.en: : I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。

lines.en: : Hey, Wakana. I’m glad to hear you’re doing fine.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Wakana。听你过得不错我就放心了。

lines.en: : I need your help.
lines.zh: : 我需要你帮忙。

lines.en: : I’m not grading any more papers for you.
lines.zh: : 我不会再帮你改卷子了。

lines.en: : Good. What you did to those papers could barely be called “grading” to begin with.
lines.zh: : 很好。你上次对那些卷子做的事，本来就算不上「批改」。

lines.en: : In my defense, you never told me to grade them correctly.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，你从没要求我改对。

lines.en: : I hope you choke and die on the next thing you eat.
lines.zh: : 我希望你被下一口吃的东西噎死。

lines.en: : When is the soonest you can get here?
lines.zh: : 你最快多久能到？

lines.en: : You're not going to feed me, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会是要给我做饭吃吧？

lines.en: : Not at this rate.
lines.zh: : 按这个速度，不会。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : Cooking is difficult. I need help.
lines.zh: : 做饭太难了。我需要帮忙。

lines.en: : From me?
lines.zh: : 找我？

lines.en: : From anyone. This is an absolute emergency.
lines.zh: : 找谁都行。这是绝对的紧急情况。

lines.en: : Why not ask your girlfriend for help?
lines.zh: : 为什么不找你女朋友帮忙？

lines.en: : Because I can’t. Are you coming or not?
lines.zh: : 因为我不能。你到底来不来？

lines.en: Well...it’s not like I have anything else to do.
lines.zh: 好吧……反正我也没别的事干。

lines.en: : Normally, my [niece] is the one that cooks. I don’t really know-
lines.zh: : 平时都是我[niece]做饭。我真不太——

lines.en: : Wonderful. I’ll see you in five minutes.
lines.zh: : 好极了。五分钟后见。

lines.en: : But I don’t even know where you live yet.
lines.zh: : 可我连你住哪儿都不知道。

lines.en: : Figure it out, imbecile. I don’t have time for these pathetic games of yours.
lines.zh: : 自己想办法，蠢货。我没空陪你玩这些可悲的游戏。

lines.en: : What does that-
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思——

lines.en: I feel like people have been hanging up on me a lot lately.
lines.zh: 我感觉最近挂我电话的人有点多。

lines.en: I am very much not a fan of this.
lines.zh: 我非常不喜欢这样。

lines.en: scene black
I start walking in a random direction and hope that it’s the right one.
lines.zh: 我朝一个随机的方向开始走，希望方向是对的。

lines.en: Thankfully, I do receive a text from Wakana several minutes later with the address of her apartment complex and begin to make my way there...
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，几分钟后 Wakana 发来短信，给了她公寓的地址，我开始往那边走……

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook1
: Well, this is an exciting coincidence.
lines.zh: : 哟，这巧合可真让人兴奋。

lines.en: So, as it turns out, my favorite non-me teacher is the next door neighbor of my favorite waitress.
lines.zh: 结果证明，我最喜欢的非我本人的老师，是我最喜欢的女服务员的隔壁邻居。

lines.en: I knew the address looked familiar when Wakana sent it to me, but I didn’t really expect it to be this familiar.
lines.zh: Wakana 把地址发给我时我就觉得眼熟，但真没料到会眼熟到这个程度。

lines.en: If I had known she lived next to Kaori, I would have just asked her to help Wakana cook.
lines.zh: 要是我早知道她住在 Kaori 隔壁，我就会直接叫 Kaori 来帮 Wakana 做饭了。

lines.en: If...Kaori even knows how to cook and isn’t just strictly a waitress.
lines.zh: 前提是……Kaori 会做饭，而不只是个服务员。

lines.en: Also, I’d need to be positive that Wakana wouldn’t be cooking anything with chicken.
lines.zh: 而且我还得确认 Wakana 做的东西里没有鸡肉。

lines.en: Even though Kaori eats chicken.
lines.zh: 尽管 Kaori 是吃鸡肉的。

lines.en: You know what? I don’t even know why I’m thinking about this when Kaori isn’t the one I’m here to see.
lines.zh: 你知道吗？我连自己在想这个都说不上来为什么——我今晚来要见的又不是 Kaori。

lines.en: I’ll just knock on Wakana’s door and-
lines.zh: 我就直接敲 Wakana 的门然后——

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook2
: Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.
lines.zh: : 人为朋友舍命，人的爱心没有比这个大的。

lines.en: : You are my friends if you do what I command.
lines.zh: : 你们若遵行我所吩咐的，就是我的朋友了。

lines.en: : I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master’s business.
lines.zh: : 以后我不再称你们为仆人，因仆人不知道主人所做的事。

lines.en: : Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.
lines.zh: : 我乃称你们为朋友，因我从我父所听见的，已经都告诉你们了。

lines.en: : Hi, John.
lines.zh: : 嗨，John。

lines.en: : Sup.
scene wakanatriestocook1
I knock on Wakana’s door and completely ignore my most recent exchange with a chicken.
lines.zh: 我敲了 Wakana 的门，把刚才跟一只鸡的那番对话彻底抛到脑后。

lines.en: : Come in right now. The door is unlocked.
lines.zh: : 马上进来。门没锁。

lines.en: : Can you be a little happier to see me at least?
lines.zh: : 至少你能表现得高兴一点见到我吗？

lines.en: : No. Open the fucking door.
lines.zh: : 不能。把那操蛋的门打开。

lines.en: scene black
Why is it that I decided to walk across town to help a woman in a committed relationship cook despite having no idea how to do so myself?
lines.zh: 我到底为什么决定横穿整座城去帮一个有对象的女人做饭，而我自己根本不会做？

lines.en: And why was John just standing outside underneath a light without Kaori?
lines.zh: 还有 John 为什么一个人站在外面的灯底下，Kaori 不在？

lines.en: Why is tonight so weird by even the standards of my life?
lines.zh: 为什么今晚连以我的人生标准来看都这么怪？

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook3
: Let’s do this.
lines.zh: : 开始吧。

lines.en: Am I actually asleep right now?
lines.zh: 我现在其实是在睡觉吧？

lines.en: There’s no way any of this is actually happening, right?
lines.zh: 这一切不可能真的在发生，对吧？

lines.en: : I need an explanation.
lines.zh: : 我需要一个解释。

lines.en: : I need a fucking drink.
lines.zh: : 我需要一杯操蛋的酒。

lines.en: : What is happening right now?
lines.zh: : 现在到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook4
: Hah...it’s my anniversary with Osako and I want to do something nice for her since she’s always the one who does...everything.
lines.zh: : 哈……今天是我和 Osako 的纪念日，我想为她做点好的，因为一直是她在做……所有事。

lines.en: : But I am entirely useless outside of[school] and hope that having someone else equally as useless will not only help in some way, but make me feel better about my shortcomings as a lover.
lines.zh: : 可我离开[school]就一无所用，我希望找个跟我一样没用的人，不但能帮上点忙，还能让我对自己作为恋人的无能感觉好一点。

lines.en: : Well, you called the right guy. If there is anyone who can make other people look better by simply being next to them, it’s me.
lines.zh: : 那你算找对人了。要说有谁光是站在旁边就能把别人衬托得更好，那就是我。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook5
: Wonderful. Except you omitted the detail where you were the one who called me.
lines.zh: : 好极了。除了你漏掉了「是你先打给我的」这个细节。

lines.en: : As if I’d ever stoop so low as to contact you first. Please.
lines.zh: : 好像我什么时候会低贱到主动联系你似的。拜托。

lines.en: : Wakana...you’re not actually a tsundere, are you?
lines.zh: : Wakana……你该不会其实是个傲娇吧？

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook6
: If by “tsundere” you mean “woman who would sooner copulate with a meat cleaver,” then yes. I believe I am.
lines.zh: : 如果「傲娇」指的是「宁可跟一把剁肉刀交配的女人」，那我想是的。

lines.en: : I feel like you would immensely regret that decision seconds in.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你刚进去几秒就会后悔得要死。

lines.en: : They both seem like incredibly regrettable decisions. Now, help me.
lines.zh: : 看起来两个都是极其会让人后悔的决定。行了，帮我。

lines.en: : With what? What are you even trying to make?
lines.zh: : 帮什么？你到底想做什么？

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook7
: I don’t know...soup?
lines.zh: : 我不知道……汤？

lines.en: : In a frying pan?
lines.zh: : 用煎锅？

lines.en: : ...Cake?
: ...In a frying pan?
lines.zh: : ……用煎锅？

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook8
: I told you I don’t normally do this, didn’t I?!
lines.zh: : 我说了平时不干这个的，不是吗？！

lines.en: I harness my inner Tsuneyo and tell Wakana everything I know about cooking soup.
lines.zh: 我唤醒内心的 Tsuneyo，把我所知道的一切关于煮汤的知识告诉 Wakana。

lines.en: : Okay, okay.
lines.zh: : 好好好。

lines.en: : First, you’re going to need a pot.
lines.zh: : 首先，你需要一口锅。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook9
: Okay.
: Then what?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？

lines.en: : That’s all I’ve got.
lines.zh: : 我就知道这些了。

lines.en: I’m sorry, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 对不起，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook10
: I was not designed for love.
lines.zh: : 我生来就不是为爱而设计的。

lines.en: : Same.
lines.zh: : 同感。

lines.en: : Let’s just see what you have in your house and try to go from there.
lines.zh: : 看看你家里有什么，从那儿开始吧。

lines.en: : Worse comes to worst, Osako comes home and you can play up how bad you are at cooking and be all endearing about it or something.
lines.zh: : 最坏的情况，Osako 回来，你可以把你有多不会做饭演一演，装得可爱一点什么的。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook11
: Me? Endearing?
lines.zh: : 我？可爱？

lines.en: : She’s the cute one. I just lie on the bed and have her rub my feet all night.
lines.zh: : 她才是可爱的那个。我就躺在床上，让她给我揉一整晚的脚。

lines.en: : Why does she like you again?
lines.zh: : 那她到底看上你什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Foot fetish, maybe?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许是恋足？

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter. Just...go look around for ingredients or something.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。你……去翻翻食材什么的。

lines.en: : I think you would know better where you keep all of the ingredients in this apartment.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你更清楚这屋里食材都放在哪儿。

lines.en: : And you’d be greatly mistaken in doing so.
lines.zh: : 你这么想就大错特错了。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook12
I walk past Wakana into the living room slash bedroom to begin my search.
lines.zh: 我从 Wakana 身边走过，进了那间既是客厅又是卧室的房间，开始搜索。

lines.en: : When I said search, I meant the fucking kitchen, you pathetic baboon.
lines.zh: : 我说搜，是指搜那操蛋的厨房，你这可悲的狒狒。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook3
I immediately return to Wakana after slightly invading her privacy.
lines.zh: 稍微侵犯了一点她的隐私后，我立刻回到 Wakana 身边。

lines.en: : I figured I could cover the bedroom while you handled the kitchen.
lines.zh: : 我想着我负责卧室，你负责厨房。

lines.en: : I sleep in that room. And rather frequently, might I add.
lines.zh: : 我睡在那屋里。而且补充一句，睡得还挺频繁。

lines.en: : Now the entire thing needs to be professionally cleaned before I can even set foot inside.
lines.zh: : 现在整个房间都得请专业清洁来弄一遍，我才能踏进去。

lines.en: : Thank you for making my night so much more difficult than it already was.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你让我今晚比原本更加艰难。

lines.en: : I barely stepped inside.
lines.zh: : 我就踏进去了一点点。

lines.en: : I’d need it professionally cleaned if you even thought about stepping inside.
lines.zh: : 你哪怕只是「想」踏进去，我都得请专业的来清洁。

lines.en: : Open some cabinets. Check the freezer. Do something. Anything.
lines.zh: : 打开几个橱柜。看看冷冻室。做点什么。随便什么。

lines.en: : Osako should already be on her way home.
lines.zh: : Osako 应该已经在回家的路上了。

lines.en: : And you waited this long? Are you insane?
lines.zh: : 你居然拖到现在？你疯了吗？

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook8
: Less talking, more scavenging! Go go go!
lines.zh: : 少说话，多翻找！快快快！

lines.en: scene black
I do as Wakana says (Not because I believe it will increase my chances of having sex with her, but because she kind of scares me) and start frantically opening cabinets.
lines.zh: 我照 Wakana 说的做（不是因为我觉得这样能提高跟她上床的几率，而是因为她有点吓人），开始疯狂地开橱柜。

lines.en: My search ends with several things that I think might...probably work in soup: salt, chicken stock, and some weird packet with red stuff in it.
lines.zh: 我最后找到几样我觉得……大概能放进汤里的东西：盐、鸡汤底，还有一包装着红色东西的怪袋子。

lines.en: That last one is a shot in the dark, but it’s not like I have any idea what I’m doing and bringing only two things to the table sounds lame.
lines.zh: 最后那个纯属瞎蒙，反正我也不知道自己在干什么，而且只拿两样东西上桌听起来太寒酸了。

lines.en: : Okay...I found some things.
lines.zh: : 好……我找到些东西了。

lines.en: : What do you have?
lines.zh: : 你有什么？

lines.en: : Salt, chicken stock, and some red stuff.
lines.zh: : 盐、鸡汤底，还有一包红色的东西。

lines.en: : Red? That sounds spicy. Osako doesn’t like spicy.
lines.zh: : 红色的？听着像辣的。Osako 不吃辣。

lines.en: : Just trust me on this, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 这你就信我一次吧，Wakana。

lines.en: : Fuck it. Throw it in.
lines.zh: : 管他妈的。倒进去。

lines.en: Wakana manages to find a pot and we each take turns dumping our hauls into it.
lines.zh: Wakana 总算找出了一口锅，我们轮流把手里的东西往里倒。

lines.en: Among her ingredients is a full carrot, some instant noodles, half a bottle of mayonnaise, and several soy sauce packets from a take out restaurant.
lines.zh: 她的食材包括一整根胡萝卜、一些泡面、半瓶蛋黄酱，还有几包从外卖店拿的酱油包。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook13
: How do you think this will be?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这会怎么样？

lines.en: : Horrible.
lines.zh: : 难吃至极。

lines.en: : How hot do we make it? Is it possible to burn soup?
lines.zh: : 火要开多大？汤有可能烧糊吗？

lines.en: : I say just turn it up as high as it goes if Osako is on her way home. That way, we can make sure it’s completely cooked by the time she gets here.
lines.zh: : 我说既然 Osako 在回来的路上，那就直接开到最大。这样能保证她到家时它已经彻底熟了。

lines.en: : Fine. But if the soup burns, I’m pouring it down your throat. Wasting food is unacceptable when there are children all over the world dying of starvation.
lines.zh: : 行。但要是汤糊了，我就灌进你喉咙里。世界上还有孩子在饿死的时候，浪费食物是不可接受的。

lines.en: : Sucks to be them.
lines.zh: : 那他们真倒霉。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook14
: It sucks to be anyone. Life is miserable and we’re all going to die.
lines.zh: : 谁都倒霉。人生就是悲惨的，我们都会死。

lines.en: : You know, food is nice and all, but what I think would make Osako really happy is if you were able to not hate yourself for a day.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，食物什么的当然好，但我觉得真正能让 Osako 开心的，是你能不能有那么一天不讨厌自己。

lines.en: : I’m even worse at that than I am at cooking.
lines.zh: : 那事我比做饭还差。

lines.en: : I also think she would have appreciated it if you just bought her something instead.
lines.zh: : 我还觉得，你要是直接买个礼物给她，她可能更领情。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook15
: No. It has to be handmade.
lines.zh: : 不行。必须得是亲手做的。

lines.en: : I can avoid cooking like the plague 364 days out of the year, but on this one, I need to at least try.
lines.zh: : 一年里我可以有 364 天像躲瘟疫一样躲着做饭，但就这一天，我至少得试一次。

lines.en: : If I can overcome this hurdle, Osako will see that I am not just a self-loathing blob of hatred with complete control over this apartment’s interior design.
lines.zh: : 如果我能跨过这道坎，Osako 就会看到，我不只是一团自厌的仇恨，只会在这间公寓的室内设计上逞威风。

lines.en: : You mean all of that black and purple in the living room wasn’t Osako’s choice?
lines.zh: : 你是说客厅那一片黑和紫不是 Osako 挑的？

lines.en: : Excuse me for wanting to share my somber view of the world and its inhabitants with all who choose to enter my home.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，我就是想跟所有愿意走进我家的人分享我对这个世界及其居民的阴郁看法。

lines.en: : And how many people enter this home, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那到底有多少人进这个家？

lines.en: : Osako. And now you, I suppose.
lines.zh: : Osako。还有现在大概算上你。

lines.en: : While we wait for this to finish cooking, would you mind looking up the price of professional cleaners?
lines.zh: : 等它煮好之前，你介意帮我查一下专业清洁的价钱吗？

lines.en: : I’ll just ask Makoto to come here and do it if it’s really that much of an issue. She’ll be here in like five minutes if I ask her to be.
lines.zh: : 要是真那么要紧，我就叫 Makoto 来弄。我开口的话她五分钟就能到。

lines.en: : Please don’t bother Miyamura with such a trivial task when she should be burying her nose in a textbook and exercising that prodigious brain.
lines.zh: : 别拿这种鸡毛蒜皮的事去麻烦宫村，她该把鼻子埋在课本里，锻炼她那天才的脑子。

lines.en: : Also, is it just me, or is the soup turning solid?
lines.zh: : 还有，是我一个人的错觉吗，这汤在变硬？

lines.en: : Yeah, I noticed that as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也注意到了。

lines.en: : That’s not supposed to happen, is it?
lines.zh: : 这不该发生吧？

lines.en: : Probably not.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook16
: Wakana! Happy anniversary! Sorry I had to spend most of the day working but, I-
lines.zh: : Wakana！纪念日快乐！抱歉我大半天都得工作，但我——

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook17
: What is he doing here?
lines.zh: : 他在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: : 什么也没干。

lines.en: : Hah...I suppose the jig is up.
lines.zh: : 哈……看来纸包不住火了。

lines.en: : Jig?...What jig?
lines.zh: : 纸？……什么纸？

lines.en: : What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook18
: What’s going on? Why are you in our apartment?
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？你为什么在我们家？

lines.en: : I knew Wakana and you were friends, but since when are you two-
lines.zh: : 我知道你和 Wakana 是朋友，但从什么时候起你俩——

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook19
: I’m sorry, Osako. I truly am.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Osako。真的对不起。

lines.en: : Sorry for what?...What happened?
lines.zh: : 对不起什么？……发生什么了？

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook20
: I wanted to cook dinner for you to celebrate our anniversary, but I am inherently incapable of doing anything other than teaching.
lines.zh: : 我想给你做顿晚饭庆祝纪念日，可我除了教书，天生干不了任何别的事。

lines.en: : And so I called the only other person I’m in regular contact with to assist me, but lo and behold, he is inherently capable of even less.
lines.zh: : 所以我叫了唯一一个我还经常联系的人来帮忙，可你猜怎么着，他天生干得更差。

lines.en: Is Wakana actually covering for me right now? Or did she just forget that I’m the one who called her?
lines.zh: Wakana 现在是在帮我打掩护？还是她忘了其实是我先打给她的？

lines.en: Either way, I don’t bother refuting the thing about me being even less capable than her because this is probably something I should stay out of until it cools down a little.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我没去反驳「我比她还差」那句，因为这事我大概该等它凉一凉再掺和。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook21
: Wakana...you...
lines.zh: : Wakana……你……

lines.en: : You did that for me?
lines.zh: : 你为我做了这个？

lines.en: : But you hate cooking. This is the first time you’ve even tried since last year, and that time you weren’t even able to figure out how to turn the stove on.
lines.zh: : 可你讨厌做饭。这是你去年来第一次尝试之后头一回，而上次你连灶怎么开都没搞明白。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Osako. I’ll accept gracefully if you want to put me out of my misery.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Osako。如果你想让我解脱痛苦，我会优雅地接受。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook22
: Nonononononono, it’s totally okay. I’m really happy you tried.
lines.zh: : 不不不不不不，完全没事。你愿意尝试我真的很开心。

lines.en: : I was just a little surprised to see you with someone else when I came home. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是回家看到你跟别人在一起，有点吃惊。就这样。

lines.en: : I...guess I just kind of figured it would be just us tonight.
lines.zh: : 我……大概只是以为今晚会是我们两个人。

lines.en: : I was really only dropping by to help Wakana. I’ll leave now.
lines.zh: : 我只是顺路来帮 Wakana 的。我现在就走。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook23
: Uhh...sorry if it seemed like I was accusing you of something.
lines.zh: : 呃……抱歉，如果刚才看起来像我在指责你什么。

lines.en: : I...get jealous a little too easy, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我……大概是吃起醋来太容易了。

lines.en: : I’m sure I’d feel the same way in your shoes.
lines.zh: : 换我站在你的位置，我想我也会一样。

lines.en: : Also, do you have any idea what that packet of red stuff in the pantry was? Because the soup very clearly came out wrong and I would like to confirm that it was Wakana's fault.
lines.zh: : 还有，你知道储藏柜里那包红色的东西是什么吗？因为这汤明显做坏了，我想确认一下是不是 Wakana 的错。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook24
: Packet of...red stuff?
lines.zh: : 一包……红色的东西？

lines.en: : Yeah. It was between a packet of blue stuff and a packet of yellow stuff.
lines.zh: : 对。它夹在一包蓝色的和一包黄色的中间。

lines.en: : Blue stuff...and...yellow-
lines.zh: : 蓝色的东西……还有……黄色的——

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook25
: Jell-O?...
: Oh. You like Jell-O.
lines.zh: : 哦。你喜欢吃果冻。

lines.en: : Perhaps dinner isn’t ruined after all.
lines.zh: : 也许晚饭还没毁掉。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook26
: How about I just...run to the convenience store really quick and grab some real ingredients for the two of us to make dinner with?
lines.zh: : 要不我就……赶紧跑去便利店买点真正的食材，我们俩一起做晚饭？

lines.en: : I can show you how to cook if you really do want to learn for next year.
lines.zh: : 如果你真的想为明年学一学，我可以教你怎么做饭。

lines.en: : If you’d be so kind as to do that...
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意这么做的话……

lines.en: : Of course. Anything for you.
lines.zh: : 当然。为你什么都行。

lines.en: : And on that note, I’ll be leaving.
lines.zh: : 那么，我就先走了。

lines.en: : But I’d like to part with saying happy anniversary and-
lines.zh: : 但我想在走之前说一句纪念日快乐，还有——

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook27
: Actually, why don’t you tag along with me if you’re on your way out?
lines.zh: : 对了，既然你要出去，为什么不跟我一起走？

lines.en: : There’s something I kind of want to talk to you about anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我也有点事想跟你说。

lines.en: : Please don’t quit the maid cafe just because you got to keep your job at the dojo.
lines.zh: : 别因为保住了道场的工作就辞掉女仆咖啡厅啊。

lines.en: : I’m not allowed to quit the maid cafe. Wakana would kill me.
lines.zh: : 我不能辞女仆咖啡厅。Wakana 会杀了我。

lines.en: : Humanely. But yes.
lines.zh: : 人道的杀法。但没错。

lines.en: : Are you sure? It seems like I’ve already kind of gotten in the way of things by turning your soup into a sugary dessert.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？看起来我已经把你的汤变成了甜点，多少搅了局。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure. It won’t take long anyway since it’s only right down the road.
lines.zh: : 嗯，确定。反正就在路下边，花不了多久。

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook28
: Babe, could I ask you to maybe clean out the pot for me while I’m gone?
lines.zh: : 宝贝，趁我不在，能不能请你帮我把锅洗了？

lines.en: : You want me to throw away the dinner I worked so hard on?
lines.zh: : 你想让我把我辛辛苦苦做的晚饭倒掉？

lines.en: : I mean, I guess we could try eating it if that’s-
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果你想的话，我们可以试着吃掉它——

lines.en: : I’m joking.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的。

lines.en: : Of course I’ll clean out the pot for you.
lines.zh: : 我当然会帮你把锅洗了。

lines.en: : Hurry home, though.
lines.zh: : 不过要快点回来。

lines.en: : I bought a new rope that should be a little easier on-
lines.zh: : 我买了根新绳子，应该会稍微——

lines.en: scene wakanatriestocook29
: JUST...T-TELL ME ABOUT IT LATER!
lines.zh: : 就……以……以后再跟我说！

lines.en: : So cute. Please do hurry back.
lines.zh: : 真可爱。请务必快点回来。

lines.en: scene black
$ wakana_love += 1
$ wakanadate5 = True
Wakana’s affection has increased to [wakana_love]!
lines.zh: Wakana 的好感度提升到了 [wakana_love]！
